run_bleurt_score: run BLEURT scoring on prediction and reference sentence pairs to compute similarity scores
create_bleurt_metric: create a BLEURT metric instance with a specified checkpoint model for text generation evaluation
test_bleurt_compute: test the BLEURT _compute method with prediction and reference lists to return similarity scores
review_bleurt_download: review the BLEURT _download_and_prepare method that downloads and initializes a checkpoint scorer
summarize_bleurt_info: summarize the BLEURT _info method that returns metric metadata, features, and citation details
